weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.title: Meeting your patient for the first time
weeks.description: 첫인사부터 호칭 확인, 세션 안내까지. 환자가 편안하게 대화를 시작할 수 있도록 연습해요.
weeks.scenario: 허리 통증으로 처음 내원한 John Thompson. 물리치료사 Alex가 환자를 맞이하고 오늘의 진행 과정을 안내합니다.
expressions: Is it okay if I call you John?
How was your trip here today?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Hi, are you John Thompson?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: I'm Alex, I'll be your physiotherapist today.

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Nice to meet you, John.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Is it okay if I call you John, or would you prefer Mr Thompson?
lines.ko: John이라고 불러도 괜찮을까요, 아니면 Thompson 씨라고 불러드릴까요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: John is fine, thanks.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Great, thanks, John.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: How was your trip here today?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Not too bad. I found parking quite easily.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Good to hear. So today I'll ask you a few questions about your back,
lines.ko: 다행이네요. 오늘은 허리에 대해 몇 가지 질문을 드리고,

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: and then see how your back moves.
lines.ko: 그다음 허리가 어떻게 움직이는지 살펴볼 거예요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Does that sound okay?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, that sounds fine.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Great. Before we start,

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: is there anything you'd like to ask me?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: No, I think that's everything.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: Reading & Key Expressions
weeks.description: 먼저 눈으로 읽으며 의미를 이해한 뒤, 소리 내어 읽어 보세요. 명확하고 자연스러운 속도에 집중하세요.
weeks.scenario: John says he wants to sit more comfortably at work, sleep better and return to his usual walks. He is unsure which goal to focus on first.
expressions: What would you most like to get back to doing?
Is that another priority for you?
That sounds like a good place to start.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: John, what would you most like to get back to doing?
lines.ko: John, 어떤 활동을 가장 다시 하고 싶으세요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: I'd like to sit at work without constantly having to change positions.
lines.ko: 직장에서 계속 자세를 바꾸지 않고 앉아 있고 싶어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: How long do you usually need to sit for at work?
lines.ko: 직장에서는 보통 얼마나 오래 앉아 계셔야 하나요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Sometimes I have meetings that last about half an hour.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: So sitting through a 30-minute meeting

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: more comfortably would be useful?
lines.ko: 좀 더 편하게 앉아 있을 수 있으면 도움이 되겠네요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, definitely.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: You also mentioned wanting to get back to running.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Is that another priority for you?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, I'd really like to run again,

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: but sitting at work is the main problem at the moment.
lines.ko: 하지만 지금은 직장에서 앉아 있는 게 가장 큰 문제예요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: That makes sense.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Shall we start with the meeting goal as a short-term goal
lines.ko: 회의 때 편하게 앉아 있는 것을 단기 목표로 먼저 삼고,

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: and work towards getting you back to running over time?
lines.ko: 시간을 두고 다시 달릴 수 있도록 함께해 볼까요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Yes, that sounds like a good place to start.
